exponential_sequence.logarithmic_lift: Choose a_ijk=(2*pi*i)^-1 log(alpha_ijk|C). Since delta_Cech(a) is an integral coboundary when DD(alpha|C)=0, subtract an integral 2-cochain to obtain an additive O_C-valued 2-cocycle b.
exponential_sequence.zero_criterion: alpha|C is holomorphically trivial iff [b] lies in image(H^2(C,Z)->H^2(C,O_C)).

relative_mapping_cone.interpretation: The normalized restriction is the relative Deligne/Abel-Jacobi invariant of a relative lift of DD(alpha), modulo integral boundary classes.

theorem.name: Q79RelativeDeligneGerbeZeroCriterionTheorem
theorem.statement: After A104 and A105, the remaining normalized gerbe vanishes exactly when its trace-free logarithmic Cech class equals the trace-free (0,2) projection of an integral H^2(C,Z) class. Thus the global zero problem is a countable integral-period-branch system; the local 8x8 system is obtained only after fixing one branch and a Gauss-Manin trivialization.

trace_free_projection.correction_to_naive_coordinates: Globally, vanishing is an integral-period congruence. It is not certified by eight floating coordinates being merely small.
trace_free_projection.criterion: b_tf is zero as an analytic gerbe iff b_tf=P_tf(e) for some e in H^2(C,Z).
trace_free_projection.projected_integral_group_warning: The image of H^2(C,Z) in H^2(C,O_C) need not be a discrete lattice. Exact equality or a proved period-separation bound is required.
